&.notes: New project ampersand: an independently drawn loop and crossing stroke, with weight and width fitted to this revival. No historical ampersand is claimed.

J.notes: New J based on this face’s flared I entry and curved U bowl; no historical J is present.

Z.notes: New Z with the observed flared horizontal terminals and a heavier diagonal related to N.

4.notes: New lining 4 with an open diagonal counter and upright stem; stroke contrast and angular joins follow the observed figures.

1.notes: New lining 1 with an angled flag and flared baseline serif, following the face’s I and figure weight.

2.notes: New lining 2 with an open curved shoulder and a flared horizontal foot, following the observed 3 and 5.

7.notes: New lining 7 with the flat flared top of 3 and the diagonal stroke weight of the figures.

$.notes: New dollar sign using this face’s observed S with an added vertical stroke.

X.notes: Reconstruction of the tiny observed six-point X. The crossed diagonals and flared ends follow that impression; stroke contrast is redrawn to match the larger N and I. Not an unmodified trace.

Y.notes: Reconstruction of the tiny observed six-point Y. The fork, upright lower stem and flared terminals follow the impression; the larger I establishes the stem weight. Not an unmodified trace.

0.notes: Reconstruction of the tiny observed six-point zero from the larger observed O, narrowed to the figure proportion. The small scan is retained for comparison; its coarse pixels do not determine the released stroke weight.
